top_signals.title: CFTC Secures $30 Million Judgment Tied to Alleged Crypto Scam
top_signals.summary: A federal judge in Florida ordered two individuals to pay more than $30 million in restitution and penalties for allegedly defrauding more than 9,000 people in a scam involving crytocurrencies and precious metals, the US Commodity Futures Trading Commission said in a statement Wednesdsay.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
